title: Build the Security Readiness Action Pack Premium Blueprint (private preview)
objective:
Implement the Premium Blueprint described in agent-specs/security-readiness-action-pack.json. Read that spec, agents/standards.md, and AGENTS.md first.
Keep the public guided demo at /blueprints/security-readiness-action-pack and the signed-in Premium kit at /blueprints/security-readiness-action-pack/kit.
Register Security Readiness Action Pack in src/lib/blueprints.ts as access premium, using requireUser and hasActiveEntitlement. Do not add a Stripe price or a PAID_PRODUCTS entry.
Do not create or rewrite Playwright tests. e2e/security-readiness-action-pack/authenticated.spec.ts is read-only. Authenticated QA uses the automatic Playwright session refresh.
Do not change Daily Inbox or Collections behavior. Do not commit, push, merge, deploy, or publish.
acceptance_criteria: GET /blueprints/security-readiness-action-pack without a session renders a page whose h1 is 'Security Readiness Action Pack', with a visible 'Private preview' label.
The guided demo page's HTML contains a robots meta tag whose content includes 'noindex' and 'nofollow'.
The guided demo page shows the fictional data notice text exactly as specified in guided_demo.fictional_data_notice, above the first demo step.

The guided demo is a six-step stepper. It shows the text 'Step N of 6', a 'Next step' button (absent or disabled on step 6), and a 'Previous step' button (absent or disabled on step 1). Each step has a visible heading.

Step 1 shows a table with exactly 4 data rows whose account names are Business bank portal, POS admin, Payroll, and Owner personal streaming. It also shows the as-of date 2026-04-06 and the severity ladder text 'former staff still listed', 'MFA off on customer-or-money data', 'restore test = never on customer-or-money data', and 'shared login on an admin account'.
Step 2 lists exactly 1 skipped account: Owner personal streaming with reason text containing 'personal-only' and 'holds customer or money data = no'.

Step 3 lists exactly 3 queued accounts in this order: Payroll, Business bank portal, POS admin. Payroll is HIGH with text containing 'former staff still listed'. Business bank portal is HIGH with text containing 'MFA' and 'never'. POS admin is HIGH with text containing 'MFA off' and MEDIUM with text containing 'shared'.

Step 3 shows the text labels 'CONFIRMED', 'AI INTERPRETATION', and 'RECOMMENDED ACTION' as visible words, not as color or icon alone. It also shows the exact sentence 'This does not certify the company as secure.' The AI INTERPRETATION line states that the rows only repeat what you entered and do not prove an account was misused.

Step 4 shows the Payroll CONFIRMED line with still_with_company = no. Activating 'Check facts against the inventory row' reveals three rows (still_with_company, named_owner, holds_customer_or_money_data), each containing the text 'Matches', and the values no, J. Reed, and yes.

Step 5 shows the fictional closure log and a mock next-quarter run as of 2026-07-06. The run lists Payroll as closed with text containing 'access removed on 2026-04-18', lists Business bank portal as still HIGH with text containing 'MFA still off', lists POS admin as still HIGH with text containing 'MFA still off', and lists Owner personal streaming as skipped with text containing 'personal-only'.

Step 6 contains the exact sentences 'You change it in the real product. The kit changes nothing.' and 'This does not certify the company as secure.' and a link to /blueprints/security-readiness-action-pack/kit whose visible text says sign-in is required and the kit is a private preview.
Every account name, person name, date, and MFA or restore value in the demo matches the guided_demo.sample_input rows and sample_output exactly.
Neither page contains the text 'checkout', 'buy now', 'purchase', 'Buy Premium', '/month', 'per month', or a price.
Neither page contains a percentage, an hours-saved figure, or an ROI or savings claim.

The homepage (/) and the site header contain zero links whose href includes '/blueprints/security-readiness-action-pack', and /sitemap.xml does not contain '/blueprints/security-readiness-action-pack'.
GET /blueprints/security-readiness-action-pack/kit without a session redirects to /auth with the query parameter next=/blueprints/security-readiness-action-pack/kit.

Security Readiness Action Pack is registered in src/lib/blueprints.ts with id and productSlug 'security-readiness-action-pack', access 'premium', href '/blueprints/security-readiness-action-pack/kit', purchaseHref '/blueprints/security-readiness-action-pack', and badge PREMIUM. It is not added to PAID_PRODUCTS and has no Stripe price.

The kit page calls requireUser('/blueprints/security-readiness-action-pack/kit') from src/lib/auth.ts and hasActiveEntitlement(user.id, 'security-readiness-action-pack') from src/lib/payments/access.ts. It exports metadata with robots { index: false, follow: false }.

With an authenticated entitled session, the kit page renders h1 'Security Readiness Action Pack Premium Kit' and the exact label text 'Premium · Private preview'. Kit resource and interaction criteria below apply only to this entitled state.

With an authenticated session that has no Security entitlement, the kit page renders h1 'Premium is locked', does not render kit content sections such as #setup-checklist, and does not show a Buy Premium button or a Stripe price.

The kit page shows 8 resource sections with headings matching the kit_contents titles, each with an element id equal to its kit_contents id. A table of contents at the top links to each section with an href of '#<id>'.

The Quarterly Readiness Queue Prompt is shown in a <pre> element and contains these strings: 'SKIPPED', 'CONFIRMED', 'AI INTERPRETATION', 'RECOMMENDED ACTION', 'Apply the skip rules before ranking', 'Do not scan', 'Do not certify', 'Do not change passwords', 'Do not disable accounts', 'former staff', 'This does not certify the company as secure'.
The Quarter-to-Quarter Update Prompt is shown in a <pre> element and contains: 'closure log', 'closed', 'still open', 'former staff', 'Do not scan', 'Do not certify'.

Each prompt has a 'Copy Prompt' button that writes the exact <pre> text to the clipboard and changes its label to 'Copied'. If the clipboard is unavailable, it shows a visible error telling the person to copy manually.

The Skip Rules and Severity Ladder Worksheet has a visible label 'Accounts to mark out of scope (one per line)', four checkboxes with visible labels 'HIGH: former staff still listed', 'HIGH: MFA off on customer-or-money data', 'HIGH: restore never tested on customer-or-money data', and 'MEDIUM: shared login on an admin account' (all checked by default), plus a 'Generate My Readiness Rules' button.

With the defaults, the generated rules block contains 'Skip personal-only accounts (holds customer or money data = no).', 'HIGH: former staff still listed.', 'HIGH: MFA off on an account that holds customer or money data.', 'HIGH: backup restore never tested on an account that holds customer or money data.', 'MEDIUM: shared login on an admin account.', 'Never label the business secure, compliant, or certified.', 'Do not scan, connect, change passwords, or disable accounts.', and 'Pick at most 5 actions this quarter.' The block has a Copy button. The block contains no 'Always skip' line.
If all three HIGH checkboxes are unchecked, the worksheet shows the error 'Turn on at least one HIGH rule.' and generates no rules block.

When 'Accounts to mark out of scope (one per line)' is empty, the generated rules block contains no 'Always skip' line. When it contains 'Owner personal streaming', the block contains 'Always skip: Owner personal streaming'.

The Quarterly Closure Log Template shows the columns quarter_of, account, named_owner, action_taken, outcome, check_date, notes and the allowed outcomes closed, still open, skipped, deferred. Its 'Copy CSV' button writes text whose first line is 'quarter_of,account,named_owner,action_taken,outcome,check_date,notes'.

The Action Review Checklist shows 9 checkbox items with visible labels, a progress line 'Checked N of 9', and a 'Reset checklist' button that sets the count back to 0. Progress is not saved beyond the browser session.
The Fictional Sample Inventory section is labelled 'Fictional' and its Copy CSV text equals the 4 account rows and header from guided_demo.sample_input.
The Setup Checklist and the Data and Safety Guidance sections each state that file upload support and data controls in ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini differ by plan, account, and admin settings.
The kit page says that worksheet entries and checklist progress stay in this browser session and are not saved to Atlas.
With an authenticated entitled session, /my-blueprints shows the Security Readiness Action Pack card as Unlocked with an Open Blueprint link to /blueprints/security-readiness-action-pack/kit.

With an authenticated session that has no Security entitlement, /my-blueprints shows the Security Readiness Action Pack card as Locked with an Available to purchase link to /blueprints/security-readiness-action-pack and no link to the kit.

With an authenticated session, /my-blueprints still shows the free Daily Inbox Starter Kit with Open Starter Kit pointing at /blueprints/daily-inbox-briefing/starter-kit. AI Collections Assistant entitlement, Buy Premium, and checkout behavior are unchanged.

At a 393px-wide viewport, neither page scrolls horizontally (document scrollWidth minus clientWidth is 1px or less) on any demo step or kit section. Tables either wrap or scroll inside their own container.

Every interactive control on both pages can be reached with Tab and activated with Enter or Space, and shows a visible focus ring. After 'Next step' or 'Previous step', focus moves to the new step's heading.
Loading both pages produces no unexpected browser console errors or page errors, as judged by the e2e/support/fixtures.ts console filter.

Product implementation files live under app/blueprints/security-readiness-action-pack/, components/premium/security-readiness-action-pack/, and src/lib/premium/security-readiness-action-pack/. The Blueprint registry entry lives in src/lib/blueprints.ts. e2e/security-readiness-action-pack/authenticated.spec.ts is the protected acceptance test and must not be weakened, skipped, rewritten, or have assertions removed.

Authenticated QA uses the repository's automatic Playwright session refresh. If the session cannot be refreshed, QA stops with AUTH_SESSION_REFRESH_REQUIRED and that failure is not treated as a product defect.
The guided demo at /blueprints/security-readiness-action-pack renders without sign-in on desktop and a phone-sized viewport, uses only fictional data, and says so.

The kit at /blueprints/security-readiness-action-pack/kit requires requireUser and hasActiveEntitlement. Entitled users see Premium · Private preview kit content. Non-entitled users see Premium is locked. No Stripe price, checkout, or Buy Premium.
Both pages set robots noindex and are not linked from the homepage, header, or sitemap. Signed-in users see Security in My Blueprints through src/lib/blueprints.ts.
Confirmed facts, AI interpretation, and recommended actions are labelled separately, and every external action stays with the person.
Do not create or rewrite Playwright tests. e2e/security-readiness-action-pack/authenticated.spec.ts is read-only. Authenticated QA uses automatic session refresh.
The Daily Inbox Briefing, its Starter Kit, its tests, and AI Collections Assistant behavior are unchanged.
